name: Starship Console
framework: An original homage to the elbow-framed console style of a famous starship computer interface

elements.name: Alert
elements.doc: Alert banner (red by default): Alert("HULL BREACH", message: "DECK 07 SEALED") · severity: .warning | .info

elements.name: Bar
elements.doc: A horizontal colour bar segment that fills the row: Bar().color(.peach) · .variant(.capTrailing) rounds its end · .frame(width: 80) fixes it

elements.name: Button
elements.doc: Button("ACKNOWLEDGE") — a pill; variants by end shape, colours with .color(…)

elements.name: Cascade
elements.doc: A block of scrolling numbers, one row per line: Cascade("0447 1138 22\n…")

elements.name: ConsoleButton
ConsoleFrame
elements.doc: Elbow-framed console: ConsoleFrame("ENVIRONMENTAL", code: "07-3341", sidebar: { SidebarButton… }, bars: { Bar… }) { content } footer: { Bar… } · .color(.lavender) recolours the elbows

elements.name: ConsoleLog
elements.doc: Console log: ConsoleLog("$ status --all\n> ALL SYSTEMS NOMINAL", title: "LOG 4417")

elements.name: ConsoleTabs
elements.sample: ConsoleTabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: DataGrid
elements.doc: Rows of coloured numbers: DataGrid(columns: ["DECK", "O2", "TEMP"], rows: […])

elements.name: Elbow
Frame
Gauge
elements.doc: Gauge(value: 0.6) { Text("LOAD") } — drawn as a segmented bar

elements.name: ListItem
elements.doc: Console list row with a coloured lead block: ListItem("PORT NACELLE", subtitle: "…", detail: "98.2")

elements.name: Meter
elements.doc: Segmented bar meter: Meter("SHIELD HARMONICS", value: 0.72, showValue: true).color(.periwinkle)

elements.name: Panel
elements.doc: A small bracket-framed panel: Panel("SENSOR GRID", code: "4417") { content } · .color(.periwinkle)

elements.name: Pill
elements.doc: Pill button with a right-aligned label: Pill("ENGAGE", code: "22").color(.peach)

elements.name: Readout
elements.doc: Big numeric readout: Readout("CORE TEMP", value: "2417", change: "+0.4", unit: "KELVIN").color(.tan)

elements.name: RedAlert
elements.doc: The full red-alert banner with striped end caps: RedAlert("CONDITION RED", message: "ALL HANDS")

elements.name: SegmentedBar
SensorGrid
elements.doc: Sensor grid display without the sweep beam

elements.name: SensorSweep
elements.doc: Sensor sweep display: rings, grid and a sweep beam; pins: [(x, y, "CONTACT 1")]

elements.name: SidebarButton
elements.doc: A full-width side-bar block: SidebarButton("SENSORS", code: "03-1147").color(.lavender) · .selected() lights it

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Dialog
elements.sample: Dialog("Rename file", message: "Enter a new name for the report.", actions: { Button("Cancel"); Button("Rename") }) { TextField("Name", text: "Quarterly report") }

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])
elements.sample: MessageBubble("Running ten minutes late because the train stopped outside the station, so please start the meeting without me.", author: "Ana Lima", time: "09:41")

elements.name: NavigationSplitView
Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Sheet
Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: Tab
TabView
elements.sample: TabView() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Tabs
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Toast
elements.sample: Toast("Message sent", description: "Your reply reached 3 people.", action: "Undo", systemImage: "checkmark.circle")

elements.name: Tooltip
elements.sample: Tooltip("Share a link to this page") { Button("Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.name: VideoPlayer
elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:
